## Job Description (archived verbatim)

Graduate AI Engineer — Sydney (hybrid)

You will build LLM-powered tools for our analysts: multi-step agent pipelines, evaluation harnesses
and the internal UIs that put them in front of people.

Must have:
- A degree in computer science or a related field (completed or final year)
- Python and one web framework (React / Next.js preferred)
- Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs

Nice to have:
- Evaluation of model outputs (golden sets, regression tests)
- Computer vision

Salary: AUD 95,000 – 105,000 + super
